extracted.intended_audience: general readers, researchers, librarians, educators, and anyone interested in book censorship and banned books
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic index page that collects and links to lists of books that have been banned, prohibited, or censored, organized primarily by the authority responsible and by jurisdiction/topic. Useful as a starting point for locating country‑ or topic‑specific lists and related censorship incidents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion criterion: banned/prohibited/censored by government or religious authority
rubrics_metrics.description: This is an index of lists of banned books, which contain books that have been banned, prohibited or censored by government or religious authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The central inclusion rule for the linked lists is that the works have been subject to official prohibition, ban, or censorship by either governmental bodies or religious authorities. Examples on the page include references to specific banned works (e.g., Mein Kampf) and cross‑links to broader 'book censorship' articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization: By government (jurisdictional lists)
rubrics_metrics.description: By government — Main article: List of books banned by governments. See also: Book banning in the United States (2021–present), Book censorship in Canada, Book censorship in Hong Kong, Book censorship in India, Book censorship in Iran, Book censorship in the United States, Proposed bans of LGBT-themed books in the United States, and Russian book ban in Ukraine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page groups and links lists according to governmental jurisdiction or state action. Practically, this means separate lists exist for individual countries or political contexts (e.g., China, India, New Zealand, Russia) and for thematic government‑led campaigns (e.g., LGBTQ books). Use the country/topic links to find jurisdiction‑specific criteria and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization: By religious authority
rubrics_metrics.description: By religious authority — See also: Index Librorum Prohibitorum; List of authors and works on the Index Librorum Prohibitorum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page distinguishes bans imposed by religious institutions (historical or contemporary). It points to canonical religious prohibition lists (e.g., the Index Librorum Prohibitorum) and associated lists of authors/works affected by ecclesiastical censure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related/adjacent categories (challenges, book burning, museums, incidents)
rubrics_metrics.description: See also: Banned Books Museum; Book burning; List of book‑burning incidents; List of most commonly challenged books in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to related phenomena and categories that are distinct from outright bans but relevant to understanding censorship: 'challenged' books (attempts to remove or restrict access), physical destruction events (book burnings), and museums or compilations documenting bans. These linked categories indicate alternative dimensions by which material related to banned books is classified and studied.
